blocks.prompt:
1 Explain how the polarity of the water molecule gives water (i) thermal stability and (ii) its unique solvent abilities, and how these properties matter for pollution. (4 marks)
(Wazahat karein ke pani ke molecule ki polarity pani ko (i) thermal stability aur (ii) munfarid solvent salahiyat kaise deti hai, aur yeh khususiyaat pollution ke liye kyun aham hain.)
blocks.explanation:
Pani ka molecule (H₂O) permanent dipole hai; yehi polarity pani ko munfarid khususiyaat deti hai.

(i) Thermal stability: polarity se molecules ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds bante hain. Hydrogen bonding pani ko zyada specific heat capacity aur zyada heat of vaporisation deti hai, is liye bare aabi zakhire thermally stable hain aur temperature ki tez tabdeeli ka muqabla karte hain.

(ii) Solvent salahiyat: polarity pani ko bohat se ionic substances, jaise metallic ions, nitrates (NO₃⁻) aur phosphates (PO₄³⁻), ka achha solvent banati hai; pani ke molecules ions ko gher lete hain. Pani polar organic compounds bhi hal karta hai.

Pollution ke liye ahmiyat: chunke pani itni cheezein hal karta hai, ionic pollutants aur bohat se pesticides aur herbicides aasani se water cycle mein daakhil ho kar tik jaate hain aur bioaccumulation hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Hydrogen bonding gives water a high specific heat capacity and high heat of vaporisation.

blocks.prompt:
2 Describe the amphoteric nature and the redox potential of water as properties that control water quality. (4 marks)
(Pani ki amphoteric nature aur redox potential ko pani ke miyaar par asar andaaz khususiyaat ke tor par bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Amphoteric nature: pani acid aur base dono ki tarah kaam kar sakta hai. Pani ki self-ionisation (25°C par Kw = 1.0 × 10⁻¹⁴) pH scale ki bunyaad hai. Zyada tar aabi zindagi pH ki tabdeeli ke liye bohat hassas hai; maslan acid rain, jo SO₂ aur NOₓ ke hal hone se banti hai, H₃O⁺ ions barha kar pH kam karti hai.

Redox potential: aabi zakhire ki oxidising aur reducing tabiyat ka paimana.
• Achhi oxygen wale pani mein species apni sab se oxidised shakal, jaise SO₄²⁻ aur CO₂, mein hoti hain.
• Aaluda ya khade pani mein oxygen khatam ho jaati hai aur mahol reducing ban jaata hai; zehreele hydrogen sulphide (H₂S) aur ammonia (NH₃) bante hain.

In equilibria aur H₂O ke rawayye ko samajh kar hum andaza laga sakte hain ke contaminants kaise phailenge, badlenge aur pani ki supply par asar karenge.

blocks.prompt:
3 Define DO, BOD and COD. With the help of Table 33.1, compare very pure water, drinking water, raw sewage and industrial waste. (4 marks)
(DO, BOD aur COD ki definitions likhein. Table 33.1 ki madad se bohat khalis pani, peene ka pani, raw sewage aur industrial waste ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation:
DO (dissolved oxygen): pani mein aabi jaandaron ke saans lene ke liye dastiyab oxygen; zyada DO saaf pani ki nishani.
BOD (biochemical oxygen demand): woh oxygen jo microorganisms ko organic maadda torne ke liye aik muqarrara arse, aam tor par 20°C par paanch din, mein chahiye; organic pollution ka ishara.
COD (chemical oxygen demand): oxidising agents (KMnO₄, K₂Cr₂O₇) se organic aur inorganic substances ko chemically oxidise karne ki oxygen; kul pollution load batati hai.

Table 33.1 ki aam ranges (mg/L) table mein hain. Pollution barhne se DO girta aur BOD aur COD tezi se barhte hain; COD hamesha BOD se zyada hai kyun ke yeh inorganic oxidise hone wala maadda bhi ginti hai.

book_ref.quote: Biochemical Oxygen Demand (BOD) is the amount of oxygen required by microorganisms

blocks.prompt:
4 Describe point-source and non-point source pollution with two examples of each. (4 marks)
(Point-source aur non-point source pollution ko har aik ki do misaalon ke saath bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Point-source pollution: woh aaloodgi jo aabi zakhire mein aik akeli, alag aur pehchani ja sakne wali jagah se aaye. Ikhraj aik jagah jama hone se aksar pollution plume banta hai; foran neeche ki taraf concentration sab se zyada hoti hai aur maqami shadeed zehreelapan hota hai.
Misaalein: (1) factory jo khaas pipe se lead ya mercury salts darya mein daale; (2) chemical plant ka storage tank jo leak ho kar mitti aur phir zer-e-zameen pani mein jaaye.

Non-point source (NPS) ya diffused pollution: jab barish ya pighalti barf ka pani zameen ke oopar aur andar se guzar kar qudrati aur insani pollutants utha kar jheelon, daryaon, wetlands aur saahili pani mein daal de. Yeh toofani barish jaise mausami waqiaat par bohat munhasir hai aur kam concentration mein pollutants ka mixture wasee ilaqe mein phailata hai.
Misaalein: (1) barish ka kheton se zaid NH₄NO₃, fertilizers aur pesticides darya mein bahana; (2) roads aur car parks par behta stormwater jo engine oil, tyres ka zinc aur road salts jama kare.

book_ref.quote: Because the discharge is concentrated at one point, it often causes a pollution plume.

blocks.prompt:
5 What is microbiological pollution? Describe its sources, common pathogens and the diseases it causes. Why is boiling not enough to make all polluted water safe? (4 marks)
(Microbiological pollution kya hai? Is ke sources, aam pathogens aur bimariyan bayan karein. Ubaalna har aaluda pani ko mehfooz kyun nahi banata?)
blocks.explanation:
Microbiological pollution: nuqsan deh microorganisms (bacteria, viruses, protozoa, parasites) se pani ki aaloodgi, jo insaanon aur haiwanon ki sehat ke liye sangeen khatra hai.

Sources: bina saaf ya adhoora saaf sewage, haiwanon ka fuzla, hospital waste aur kheton ka bahao jo aabi zakhiron mein jaaye.

Aam pathogens: Escherichia coli, Salmonella aur Giardia.

Bimariyan: microorganisms water-borne bimariyon ki bari wajah hain, jaise cholera, typhoid, dysentery aur hepatitis A.

Ubaalna: yeh zyada tar bacteria, viruses aur protozoa maar kar pani peene ke qabil bana deta hai, lekin doosre pollutants (jaise heavy metals aur chemicals) sirf ubaalne se nahi nikalte.

book_ref.quote: Common pathogens found in microbiologically polluted water include

blocks.prompt:
6 Describe mercury as a water pollutant: its sources, conversion into methylmercury, and the health effects including the Minamata Disaster. (4 marks)
(Mercury ko water pollutant ke tor par bayan karein: sources, methylmercury mein tabdeeli, aur Minamata haadse samet sehat par asraat.)
blocks.explanation:
Sources: mercury zyada tar koyla jalane, sone ki mining aur thermometer ya battery industry ke waste se pani mein aata hai.

Methylmercury: aabi sediments mein bacteria inorganic mercury ko methylmercury, [CH₃Hg]⁺, mein badalte hain jo zyada khatarnak hai. Yeh charbi mein bohat hal hota hai, is liye membranes aasani se paar karke food chain mein biomagnification karta hai.

Sehat par asar: yeh taqatwar neurotoxin hai jo blood-brain barrier paar karta hai. Lambe arse ke asar se Minamata bimari hoti hai: ataxia (tawazun ki kharabi), haath paon sun hona aur pathon ki aam kamzori.

Minamata haadsa: 1950s mein Minamata, Japan mein industrial pollution ka shadeed waqia. Pani mein chhore gaye methylmercury se mercury ka zehar phaila: hazaron logon ko aasaabi nuqsan, paidaishi naqais, amwaat aur mahooliyati tabahi.

Peene ke pani mein mercury ki WHO hadd: 0.006 mg/L (Table 33.2).

book_ref.quote: Mercury can enter water primarily from coal combustion, gold mining

blocks.prompt:
7 Describe the sources and health hazards of lead and cadmium in water. Explain why cadmium makes bones brittle. (4 marks)
(Pani mein lead aur cadmium ke sources aur sehat ke khatre bayan karein. Wazahat karein ke cadmium haddiyon ko bhurbhura kyun karta hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Lead
Sources: leaded petrol (ab duniya bhar mein paabandi), purani plumbing (lead pipes), lead-acid batteries aur paints; Pb²⁺ ions aksar pipes ke corrosion se pani mein aate hain.
Khatre: lead haemoglobin ki tayyari mein rukawat daal kar anaemia karta hai. Bachon mein jama hone wala zehar hai jo na theek hone wala aasaabi nuqsan aur nashonuma mein der karta hai. WHO hadd 0.01 mg/L.

Cadmium
Sources: metal plating, plastic stabilisers aur phosphate fertilizer ki milawat. Yeh non-biodegradable hai aur food chain mein jama hota hai.
Khatre: lambe arse tak khaane se Itai-itai bimari hoti hai jis mein cadmium haddiyon mein calcium ki jagah le kar unhein bohat bhurbhura kar deta hai; gurdon ko shadeed nuqsan (nephrotoxicity) bhi deta hai. WHO hadd 0.003 mg/L.

Haddiyan bhurbhuri kyun: Cd²⁺ ions ki charge density zyada hai, is liye woh haddiyon mein Ca²⁺ ions ki jagah le lete hain.

book_ref.quote: Lead interferes with the production of haemoglobin, leading to anaemia.

blocks.prompt:
8 Describe pesticides, herbicides and PCBs as chemical pollutants of water: their sources, nature and health effects. (4 marks)
(Pesticides, herbicides aur PCBs ko pani ke chemical pollutants ke tor par bayan karein: sources, tabiyat aur sehat par asraat.)
blocks.explanation:
Pesticides aur herbicides (jaise DDT, glyphosate)
Sources: kheton ka bahao aur gharelu bagbani.
Tabiyat: DDT non-polar hai, pani mein hal nahi hota magar machhliyon aur parindon ke charbi wale tissues mein bohat hal hota hai (glyphosate is ke baraks polar aur pani mein khoob hal hone wala hai). DDT jaise purane pesticides persistent organic pollutants (POPs) hain.
Sehat par asar: bohat se pesticides estrogen jaise qudrati hormones ki tarah endocrine disruptors hain. Is se jangli haiwanon mein nasal-kashi ki nakami (jaise parindon ke andon ke chhilke patle hona) hoti hai aur insaanon mein hormonal cancers se taaluq hai; nashonuma ke masail bhi.

PCBs (polychlorinated biphenyls)
Source: transformers mein coolant; khatarnak waste ki jaghon se pani mein leak hote hain.
Sehat par asar: mumkina carcinogens; immune system dabate aur chloracne jaisi jild ki bimariyan karte hain.

Chemical pollution pani ka miyaar girati, biodiversity kam karti aur aabi nizam bigaarti hai.

book_ref.quote: They are non-polar and insoluble in water but highly soluble in the fatty tissues of fish and birds.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab mein do ghaltiyan Book correction mein theek ki gayi hain: (1) glyphosate non-polar nahi balke polar aur pani mein hal hone wala hai; sirf DDT non-polar hai. (2) PCBs 'biphenols' nahi balke polychlorinated biphenyls hain.

blocks.prompt:
9 What is eutrophication? Describe its causes, the formation of dead zones and its effects on ecosystems and human health. (4 marks)
(Eutrophication kya hai? Is ki wajohat, dead zones ke banne aur mahooliyati nizam aur insani sehat par asraat bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Eutrophication (nutrient pollution) tab hoti hai jab zyada nutrients, khaas kar nitrogen aur phosphorus, aabi zakhiron mein aa jaayein.

Wajohat: kheton ka bahao, wastewater ka ikhraj aur stormwater.

Algal blooms aur dead zones: yeh nutrients paudon ke liye zaroori hain magar in ki zyadti se algae tezi se barhti hai (algal blooms). Blooms paani ke andar ke paudon tak dhoop rokte hain. Jab yeh mar kar galte hain to bohat si oxygen kha jaate hain aur hypoxic 'dead zones' bante hain jahan aabi zindagi nahi bach sakti.

Asraat: eutrophication aabi nizam ko shadeed bigaarti, biodiversity kam karti, machhli ki sanat ko nuqsan deti aur tafreeh aur peene ke pani ka miyaar kharab karti hai.

Insani sehat: peene ke pani mein zyada nitrate bachon ke liye khaas tor par khatarnak hai; is se Blue Baby Syndrome (methaemoglobinaemia) hota hai jis mein nitrates khoon ki oxygen le jaane ki salahiyat kam kar dete hain.

book_ref.quote: Although these nutrients are essential for plant growth

blocks.prompt:
10 Describe oil pollution and plastic waste in oceans and their effects on marine life. (4 marks)
(Samandaron mein tel ki aaloodgi aur plastic waste aur samandari zindagi par un ke asraat bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Tel ki aaloodgi: jahazon se tel ka leak aur girna samandar ki satah par tezi se phail kar aik teh banata hai jo dhoop rokti aur oxygen ka tabadla kam karti hai. Is se machhliyon, parindon aur mammals ko nuqsan hota hai: mammals safai karte hue zehreela tel nigal lete hain aur machhliyon ko hydrocarbons se lambe arse ke masail hote hain. Tel mangroves, coral reefs aur saahilon ko bhi nuqsan deta hai.

Plastic aur thos waste: har saal laakhon ton plastic (botlein, thailiyan, jaal, microplastics) daryaon, jheelon aur samandaron mein phenka jaata hai. Plastic biodegrade nahi hota; chhote zarron mein toot kar sadiyon tak rehta hai.
Asraat: jaandar plastic ko khuraak samajh kar nigalte hain jis se dam ghutna ya jaan lewa andaruni zakhm hota hai; purane jaal aur malbe mein phans kar kachhuye, dolphins aur parinde zakhmi ya halaak hote hain; microplastics food chain mein aa chuke hain; thos waste aabi raaste band karta, maskan bigaarta aur miyaar girata hai.

book_ref.quote: Oil pollution in oceans, particularly from oil leaks and spills caused by ships

blocks.prompt:
11 Describe how human activities cause water pollution. Explain any four such activities. (4 marks)
(Bayan karein ke insani sargarmiyan water pollution kaise paida karti hain. Aisi koi chaar sargarmiyan samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Aabadi aur industries barhne se zyada waste aur pollutants aabi zakhiron tak pohanchte hain; waste ka ghalat intezam aur qawaneen ki kami halaat bigaarti hai.

1. Industrial sargarmiyan (sab se bara source): karkhane nuqsan deh chemicals, heavy metals aur zehreela waste seedha daryaon, jheelon aur samandaron mein daalte hain, jaise oil refineries, chemical plants, automobile industry, fertilizers aur tanneries.

2. Zarai sargarmiyan: fertilizers, pesticides aur herbicides ka bahao; ghalat aabpashi se mitti ka kataao aur sediments daryaon mein; kheton ki nikaasi satahi aur zer-e-zameen pani aaluda karti hai.

3. Gharelu aur municipal waste: bina saaf ya kam saaf sewage aur thos waste bacteria aur viruses laate hain; detergents, tel aur chemicals naaliyon mein jaate hain; naliyon ke qareeb plastic rukawat paida karta hai.

4. Jangalat ki katai aur shehri taraqqi: dheeli mitti kat kar sediment banati hai jo aabi raaste band karta hai; tameerat bahao mein pollutants aur malba daalti hai.

(Mazeed: tafreehi sargarmiyan, jahan kashtiyan tel aur fuel chhorti hain aur sayyah kachra phenkte hain; aur samandari transport, tel ke girne, jahazon ke sewage aur hull ki safai aur rang ke zariye.)

book_ref.quote: Factories often discharge harmful chemicals, heavy metals, and toxic waste directly into rivers

blocks.prompt:
12 Describe the effects of water pollution on ecosystems and biodiversity, and explain bioaccumulation and biomagnification. (4 marks)
(Water pollution ke mahooliyati nizam aur biodiversity par asraat bayan karein, aur bioaccumulation aur biomagnification samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Pollutants pani ki physical aur chemical khususiyaat badal dete hain; aam asraat: biodiversity ka nuqsan, maskanon ki tabahi, food chains mein khalal aur pani ke miyaar mein kami.

Mahooliyati nizam aur biodiversity ki tabahi: tel, heavy metals, pesticides, plastic aur waste aabi zindagi ko nuqsan dete hain. Aaluda pani oxygen kam karke hypoxia paida karta hai; coral reefs ko nuqsan aur food chains mein khalal daalta hai. Zehreele chemicals, sewage aur industrial waste jaandaron ko maarte hain aur zindagi ki rangarangi kam karte hain. Nasal-kashi, khuraak aur hijrat ke nizam bigarne se aabadi ghatti aur hassas species khatam ho sakti hain; pani par munhasir parinde aur haiwan bhi mutasir hote hain.

Bioaccumulation aur biomagnification: mercury, lead aur pesticides jaise zehar waqt ke saath jaandaron mein jama hote hain (bioaccumulation) aur food chain mein oopar jaate hue zyada concentrated hote jaate hain (biomagnification). Sab se oopar ke shikari, insaan samet, aksar sab se zyada miqdaar paate hain.

book_ref.quote: Toxic chemicals, sewage, and industrial waste can kill or harm aquatic organisms

blocks.prompt:
13 Explain how nutrient overload, soil degradation and methane emission are effects of water pollution on the environment. (4 marks)
(Wazahat karein ke nutrients ki zyadti, mitti ki kharabi aur methane ka ikhraj water pollution ke mahooliyati asraat kaise hain.)
blocks.explanation:
Nutrients ki zyadti (eutrophication): fertilizers aur sewage se zyada nitrogen aur phosphorus algae ko tezi se barhate hain jo dhoop rokti aur oxygen kam karti hai; is se nizam bigarta, machhliyan aur doosre jaandar marte aur miyaar girta hai.

Mitti ki kharabi aur paudon ka nuqsan: heavy metals, industrial waste aur zyada nutrients mitti mein jazb ho kar us ki banawat aur zarkhezi badalte hain; jama chemicals mitti ki qudrati microbial sargarmi bigaarte hain jo paudon ki sehat ke liye zaroori hai. Paudon ki barhotri rukti, patte rang badalte aur woh mar bhi sakte hain.

Methane ka ikhraj: sewage, kheton ka bahao ya industrial waste algae aur doosre jaandaron ki barhotri tez karta hai. Jab yeh oxygen ki kami (anaerobic) mein mar kar galte hain to methane, aik taqatwar greenhouse gas, nikalti hai. Zaid methane climate change aur global warming barhati hai.

book_ref.quote: As these organisms die and decompose in oxygen-poor (anaerobic) conditions

blocks.prompt:
14 Name the three levels of wastewater treatment. Describe screening, sedimentation, coagulation and flocculation. (4 marks)
(Wastewater treatment ke teen darjon ke naam likhein. Screening, sedimentation, coagulation aur flocculation bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Darje: pollution ki qisam aur shiddat ke mutabiq treatment teen darjon mein hota hai: primary (physical malba nikalna), secondary (biological processing) aur tertiary (chemical safai).

(i) Screening: pehla marhala; bare na hal hone wale zarre pani ko metal screens se guzaar kar nikale jaate hain.

Sedimentation: phir pani bare tankon mein rakha jaata hai taake latke thos zarre gravity ke asar se tah mein baith jaayein.

(ii) Coagulation aur flocculation (zaroorat ho to): bareek colloidal zarron ka baithna tez karne ke liye. Ghule contaminants (heavy metals, phosphates) na hal hone wali shakal mein precipitate kiye jaate hain. Aluminium sulphate, Al₂(SO₄)₃, jaise coagulants daale jaate hain jo chhote zarron ko jor kar bare dhele 'floc' banate hain, jo phir aasani se nikal jaate hain.

book_ref.quote: The initial stage of water treatment typically involves screening and sedimentation.

blocks.prompt:
15 Describe filtration and disinfection in water treatment. Why is filtration alone not enough? (4 marks)
(Water treatment mein filtration aur disinfection bayan karein. Sirf filtration kaafi kyun nahi?)
blocks.explanation:
(iii) Filtration: jab zyada tar thos zarre nikal jaayein to pani filter hota hai. Yeh mechanical amal hai jo baqi bareek latke zarre aur kuch microorganisms nikalta hai. Pani darja-ba-darja ret aur bajri ki tehon se guzarta hai; ret physical rukawat ban kar daanon ke darmiyan khali jagah mein zarre rok leti hai. Behtar safai ke liye activated carbon istemal hota hai.

Kaafi kyun nahi: sirf filtration ghule ions ya khurdbeeni pathogens nahi nikal sakti, is liye chemical safai zaroori hai.

(iv) Disinfection: chlorination sab se aam tareeqa hai; doosre tareeqe sodium hypochlorite (NaOCl), ya ozone (O₃), kabhi hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) ke saath. Chlorine gas ya NaOCl pani mein hypochlorous acid (HOCl) banata hai jo bacteria aur viruses ki cell walls mein ghus kar un ke kaam bigaar deta hai.

book_ref.quote: This is a mechanical process designed to remove the remaining fine suspended matter

blocks.prompt:
16 Describe how high-purity water is produced by reverse osmosis and ion exchange. Explain the softening of hard water. (4 marks)
(Reverse osmosis aur ion exchange se high-purity pani kaise banta hai, bayan karein. Hard water ko naram karna samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Zaroorat: laboratory aur zyada namkeen ilaqon mein high-purity pani chahiye; treatment ka aakhri qadam (v) reverse osmosis (RO) aur ion exchange hai.

Reverse osmosis: pani ko pressure se semi-permeable membrane se guzaara jaata hai jo ghule namak, bacteria aur doosri milawat rok leti hai.

Ion exchange aur naram karna: hard water mein Ca²⁺ aur Mg²⁺ ions zyada hote hain jo industrial processes aur saabun ki karkardagi bigaarte hain. Ion-exchange column mein yeh ions Na⁺ ya H⁺ ions se badal diye jaate hain, yun pani 'naram' ho jaata hai.

Yani RO membrane ke zariye namak aur jaraseem rokta hai, jab ke ion exchange hardness wale ions ko badal kar nikalta hai.

book_ref.quote: In an ion-exchange column, these ions are swapped for Na⁺ or H⁺ ions.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab mein treatment ke qadam 'I, ii, iii, iv, iv' chhape hain; Book correction ke mutabiq RO aur ion exchange paanchwan qadam (v) hai.

blocks.prompt:
17 Describe the strategies used for pollution control of water resources. (4 marks)
(Aabi wasail ki pollution control ke liye istemal hone wali strategies bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Aabi wasail ki hifazat ke liye pollution control in strategies se hota hai:

1. Sakht discharge standards: industries aur municipalities par lagaye jaate hain taake nuqsan deh pollutants aabi zakhiron mein na jaayein.

2. Treatment ka nizam: sewage treatment plants (STPs) ko behtar aur wasee karna, Effluent Treatment Plants (ETPs) lagana aur membrane filtration aur bioreactors jaisi jadeed technology apnana.

3. Pani ke miyaar ki musalsal nigrani: pollutants ka pata lagati aur aaloodgi par bar waqt kaarwai mumkin banati hai.

4. Jurmaane aur incentives: aaluda karne walon par sakht jurmaane aur saaf tareeqon par incentives khilaf warzi rokte aur industries aur logon ko paidaar, pollution se paak kaam par aamada karte hain.

book_ref.quote: By implementing strict penalties for polluters and offering incentives for clean practices.

blocks.prompt:
18 Why is conservation of water important today? Explain the strategies for efficient use of water. (4 marks)
(Aaj pani bachana kyun zaroori hai? Pani ke behtar istemal ki strategies samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Ahmiyat: aaj pani bachana nihayat zaroori hai kyun ke duniya ki aabadi ka bara hissa pani ki kami ka saamna kar raha hai.

Strategies:
1. Zaraat mein pani bachane wali technology: drip aur sprinkler irrigation zayaa kam karti aur paidawar barhati hai.
2. Greywater ka dobara istemal: kapre, bartan aur nahane ka pani bagbani, toilet flush aur industrial cooling mein lagana meetha pani bachata aur sewage treatment ka bojh kam karta hai.
3. Shehri aur dehi ilaqon mein barish ka pani jama karna (rainwater harvesting): pani rokne ka paidaar tareeqa.
4. Supply ke nizam ki baqaida marammat: leaks aur zayaa kam.
5. Chhote dams aur recharge wells: barish ka pani jama aur zer-e-zameen pani dobara bharna, khushk mausam ke liye.
6. Awaam ki shirkat aur aagahi: pani bachane ki taleemi muhim aur aabi zakhiron ki hifazat mein maqami logon ki shamooliyat.

book_ref.quote: Implementing rainwater harvesting systems in both urban and rural areas

blocks.prompt:
19 Describe the key Punjab acts on water pollution control and conservation, giving the scope and penalties of each (Table 33.3). (4 marks)
(Water pollution control aur pani bachane ke Punjab ke aham qawaneen bayan karein, har aik ka daaira aur saza (Table 33.3).)
blocks.explanation:
Punjab hukoomat ne kayi qawaneen banaye hain; Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Punjab tamam mutaliqa fareeqon ke liye baqaidagi se qawaid jaari karti hai. Aham qawaneen table mein hain.

Is ke ilawa gaari dhone ke liye hosepipe aur ghar ke lawn ya bagh mein flood irrigation par Pakistan Penal Code ke tehat Rs 10,000 jurmana hai.

book_ref.quote: Below is a comprehensive overview of the key self-explanatory rules and regulations

rows: Rs 5 million tak jurmana aur roz ka Rs 100,000 tak
Pollutants daalne ya bahao rokne ki mamanat
3 maah tak qaid aur/ya Rs 500,000 jurmana
Punjab Irrigation, Drainage and Rivers Act, 2023
Pani aur drainage ki fees; discharge permits ka nizam
Punjab Water and Sanitation Authority Act, 2025
Bare shehron mein mukammal resource management aur zer-e-zameen pani ki hifazat ki Authority
